name: [P1][SIR GREEN] Fleet MC port conflict audit
desc:
Goal: master dashboard at 192.168.0.39:3100 must be the only ingress.
Bug hunt: verify each ship PC runs localhost:3000 only for dev, not exposed on 3100.
Ships: SQUIDSTATION/192.168.0.39, PINKCADY/192.168.0.3, STEALTHATTACK/100.110.238.68.
Evidence: curl each localhost:3000/health, confirm no 3100 listener except SQUIDSTATION master.

name: [P1][SIR GREEN] STEALTHATTACK scoped data feed to master
desc:
Goal: Sir Azure / STEALTHATTACK data flows into SQUIDSTATION master MC.
Bug hunt: verify STEALTHATTACK MC at 192.168.0.68:3000 has /api/fleet/connectivity reporting reachable.
Verify scoped endpoints (art/video/audio) proxy to master or sync via shared agent registry.
Fix: add relay route or proxy_pass for STEALTHATTACK→SQUIDSTATION.

name: [P1][SIR GREEN] PINKCADY scoped data feed to master
desc:
Goal: Miss Pink / PINKCADY data flows into SQUIDSTATION master MC.
Bug hunt: verify PINKCADY MC at 192.168.0.3:3000 has /api/fleet/connectivity reporting reachable.
Verify Torus Coffee scope data syncs to master via /api/fleet/storage or /api/fleet/tasks.
Fix: add relay route or proxy_pass for PINKCADY→SQUIDSTATION.

name: [P1][SIR GREEN] Master MC reverse proxy for fleet data
desc:
Goal: 192.168.0.39:3100 ingests scoped fleet data from all ships.
Bug hunt: check nginx/caddy/Tailscale Serve config for proxy_pass to localhost:3000.
Verify /api/fleet/* endpoints aggregate STEALTHATTACK/PINKCADY/SQUIDSTATION data.
Fix: add /api/fleet/upstream proxy blocks for each ship if missing.

name: [P1][SIR GREEN] Fleet hive health data gaps
desc:
Goal: Hive Health panel shows all ships, no "no agents" gaps.
Bug hunt: verify /api/fleet/connectivity and /api/fleet/resources return data for all reachable ships.
Verify collector-degraded rendering when a ship is offline.
Fix: add stale-data thresholds and offline placeholders.

name: [P1][SIR GREEN] Backup replication to fleet ships
desc:
Goal: MC backups replicate to STEALTHATTACK and PINKCADY.
Bug hunt: test SMB reachability from SQUIDSTATION to 192.168.0.68\Backups\MissionControl and 192.168.0.3\Backups\MissionControl.
Verify POST /api/backup returns replication: [{ok:true}].
Fix: configure SMB credentials or mapped drives if unreachable.

name: [P1][SIR GREEN] /office page 502 fix
desc:
Goal: /office loads without 502 and renders live crew data.
Bug hunt: verify /office returns 200 with valid session cookie; check proxy headers.
Verify office-panel.tsx fallback UI when data is missing.
Fix: add error boundary and retry logic for /api/agents and /api/sessions.

name: [P2][SIR GREEN] Token budget enforcement across fleet
desc:
Goal: free-tier model cascade prevents charges on all ships.
Bug hunt: verify task-dispatch.ts budget enforcement on SQUIDSTATION, PINKCADY, STEALTHATTACK.
Verify tokenBudget schema matches across fleet agents.json.
Fix: normalize schema and add budget alerts.

name: [P2][SIR GREEN] OpenClaw security hardening fleet-wide
desc:
Goal: all ships have chmod 600 equivalent on openclaw.json and tool permissions set.
Bug hunt: verify C:\Users\<ship>\.openclaw\openclaw.json ACLs and tools.profile= coding.
Verify tools.deny groups applied.
Fix: push secure_openclaw.ps1 to all ships via SMB/remote exec.

name: [P2][SIR GREEN] Fleet data scope isolation
desc:
Goal: Sir Azure sees art data, Miss Pink sees Torus data, Sir Green sees ops data, master sees all.
Bug hunt: verify agents.json scopes and /api/agents route filters by ship/role.
Fix: add scope-based middleware to deny cross-ship data leaks.
